text:
I booked online for 900 baht under social security.
So I asked the staff via chat if there were any additional fees.
The staff said no, so I decided to book. If they had informed me in advance that there might be an additional fee, I wouldn't have come because I didn't have the money. I was out of money and had no cash. When I arrived at the branch, they told me there would be an additional fee of 300-600 baht, depending on the doctor's assessment (very high compared to other places I've been to. Usually, they only charge an additional 100 baht as a formality; the clinic wants the money, in addition to the social security).

*I continued because I already made an appointment. It would be a huge embarrassment if I were to leave over something so trivial.*

The staff at the branch were polite and provided excellent service. It wasn't my fault, but the page admin was the fault!!

I won't be returning, no matter how good the service is. I'm disappointed. I'd choose another clinic. There are so many clinics. I don't need to give this place a chance, because there are so many good options.

No matter how good the business is, the admin is lousy. 🙂
